entry.title: Vavra 0.1.0
entry.summary: First release of **Vavra for MPC**: gearmulator's Waldorf microQ emulation as a plugin instrument for MPC Gen2 standalones (MPC OS 3.10+). - The original microQ OS 2.23 on emulated hardware, ~45% of one core on an MPC Live III - 300 ROM sounds (banks A-C) plus your own sound-set files (`VST/vavra/banks/`) - Favourites in MPC's PRESET menu; the microQ's LCD live on MAIN - 15 editor pages incl. the modulation matrix, both effects and the 16-step arp pattern - Arpeggiator and clocked LFOs follow MP
